controls.gamepad_menus: A confirms · B goes back · LB/RB cycle
controls.ui_hint: In menus: arrows or WASD navigate, Tab cycles, Enter or Space confirm, Esc goes back and M mutes the audio.
controls.tip_title: The secret is in the jump.
controls.tip: Hold to jump higher and release for a short hop. Run before a gap. On a pipe with a passage, press down.

settings.sound_note: Each channel has its own volume: muting the music never mutes the effects.
settings.fullscreen_desc: Fills the whole monitor (F11 also toggles).
settings.show_fps_desc: Shows frames per second in the corner of the screen.
settings.subtitles_desc: Shows character lines and voices as text.
settings.reduced_motion_desc: Turns off interface animations and transitions.
settings.bindings_desc: Select an action and press its new primary key. A key used by another action is moved.
settings.reset_desc: Erase completed levels, records, relics and achievements on this computer.
settings.reset_confirm_desc: Saved levels, records, relics and achievements will be erased. Settings are kept.

credits.title: Lume · The Five Frontiers
credits.intro: An original platform adventure, made to celebrate exploration and the pleasure of a precise jump.
credits.art: Original pixel art drawn by code. Five worlds, fifteen paths and an identity of its own.
credits.music: Original tracks and effects synthesized in real time, with no proprietary audio files.

complete.final: The last flame is lit. The journey is yours.

gameover.description: The light is still here. Try a new route.

events.save_blocked: Progress could not be saved. It counts for this session.
events.progress_reset: A new journey begins. Progress reset.

intro_1-1.0: So this is where the light begins... The whole valley is glowing!
intro_1-1.1: Coins, glowing blocks and ancient pipes. Someone left clues for me.
intro_1-1.2: Five frontiers, five guardians. Let's find out what lies beyond the horizon.

hurt: I need to be more careful.
relic: A relic! It's warm with light.
The ancients left this for someone to find.
secret: A passage! I knew this pipe was hiding something.
Nobody has passed through here in a long time.
power_grow: I feel the light growing in me!
Now I can take a tumble.
power_fire: Flame in hand! Watch out, guardians.
boss_intro: So you're the one guarding this frontier.
I didn't come to fight. But I'm not leaving either.
Show me what you've got, guardian.
boss_defeated: Rest, guardian. I'll take care of the rest.
world_unlock: A new frontier... the air has changed.
I've never been this far from home.
Every world has its own light.
idle_long: This wind carries a new scent.

lume.name: Lume
lume.description: Bearer of the light. Balanced in everything: jumping, running and courage.

vento.name: Vento
vento.description: The taller, shy brother. Jumps higher, slides more and descends slowly while holding jump.

fagulha.name: Fagulha
fagulha.description: Fast and small. Jumps lower, but after crouching for half a second she fires a charged jump.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: A glider. Runs a little slower and can float for a moment in the air, once per jump.

pirilampo.name: Pirilampo
pirilampo.description: For those just starting: enemies don't hurt, but pits, lava and the timer still count.
